title: RitualCore Altar: Troubleshooting
summary: Fix ritual failures by checking structure, inputs, target state, and consumption gates.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: Most ritual failures are invalid array, missing pedestal input, wrong catalyst, missing active curse, or a relic state that cannot be stabilized.

blocks.title: Shrink The Attempt
blocks.body: Run diagnostics, remove optional targets, and test Aether Calibration. If calibration works, the problem is probably the bridge target.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one block, input, or target state before retrying. Randomly moving the whole altar can erase the useful clue.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
